summary: Dispatch Node Buffer.from overloads while preserving copy-vs-shared-backing-store behavior and encoding semantics.

target.notes: String input decodes according to Node encodings; Array/TypedArray inputs copy converted byte values; ArrayBuffer/SharedArrayBuffer input creates a sharing view.

semantics.string: new storage; default utf8; Node encoding rules
semantics.array_buffer: share backing store with byteOffset/length view

tests.name: typed array copies but arraybuffer shares
tests.input: const {Buffer}=require("node:buffer"); const a=new Uint8Array([1]); const c=Buffer.from(a); const s=Buffer.from(a.buffer); a[0]=9; console.log(c[0],s[0]);
